title: Accept, wait for the lock, walk away
spec: Add src/payee/take-offer.ts: takeOffer({ offer, signer, post, feeder, rail, clock, waitMs }) → { contract, state, lockRef } | { abandoned: true, reason }. Mint a hash lock, makeAccept, post the accept on the board, then wait (feeder.subscribe) for a lock frame naming the contract from the offer's DID, deadline min(claimByMs − 60 s, now + waitMs). No lock → walk away, nothing else posted. Lock present → applyFrame, then rail.verifyLock(lockTerms(state), ref); an unverifiable lock is abandoned. Return the state and the lock preimage holder (never log the preimage).
done: Scripted counterparty fixtures drive both the happy path to `locked` and the walk-away with zero extra writes.
